issues.description: Method addGuestStudents: the problem statement (and UML) specify a public method addGuestStudents(int) with a single int parameter, and the solution implementation defines public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents). However, the template starter file declares public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput) (an extra boolean parameter). This parameter-list mismatch between the template and the specification/solution will confuse students and cause API/test incompatibilities (tests and expected implementations assume a single int parameter).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template's public API match the exercise specification and the solution: change the template declaration to public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) { ... }. If input validation is desired keep it internal (validate the int parameter inside the method) or implement private/internal helpers — do not add an extra boolean parameter to the public method signature.
